text:
Ava (oncall): Pager: high error rate from serving cluster us-west-2-gpu-3, model load failures. Link to incident call: https://call.example/incident/1798501234
IncidentBot: Incident created #INC-2026-045
DeployBot: Deployed model: gpt-xl-8bit v2 at 17:04 UTC
Ava (oncall): Seeing repeated OOMs during model deserialization on gpu-3 nodes. Logs ->
```
[2026-03-14T17:05:02Z] ERROR runtime: model_deserialize failed: cuBLAS: CUBLAS_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED
[2026-03-14T17:05:02Z] ERROR runtime: fallback attempt -> OOM at load
```
Ravi (runtime): ACK. Pulling node logs + nvml stats. Suspect cuBLAS compile timeout after kernel cache invalidation. Any recent driver changes?
Marta (sre): No driver rollout. Autoscaler did spawn 2 nodes last hour.
Luis (cs): CS: Two customers reported 5xxs — both Dedicated customers in us-west-2 (cust-A, cust-B). Not full outage but elevated errors.
Ava (oncall): Paging runtime on-call @Ravi. Started call bridge.
DeployBot: Canary route split -> 50% -> fallback model gpt-xl-4bit for low-latency requests
Ravi (runtime): Running quick reproduce: ssh gpu-3-12 -> Docker logs show 'deserialization: bad magic header' on first chunk sometimes. Could be corrupted sharded checkpoint after prior preemption.
Ava (oncall): Temp mitigation options: 1) disable warmup for new allocations 2) fallback to smaller variant 3) restart affected containers 4) evict prefetchers.
Ravi (runtime): Plan: 1) drain gpu-3-12 from serving pool 2) restart runtime process with --disable-jit-compile 3) reattempt load with smaller shard-size. Doing step 1 now.
Marta (sre): I'll coordinate node drain: cordon + evict. Eviction in progress.
Ava (oncall): Progress: cordon node gpu-3-12 -> success. Evicted ~18 pods. Errors dropped from ~3/min to ~0.6/min.
Luis (cs): Update queued to customers: cust-A sees degraded perf, cust-B intermittent 503s. CS on standby.
Ravi (runtime): After restart with --disable-jit-compile, deserialization moved past previous header error but hit cuBLAS compile timeout. Increasing compile timeout via env INFER_COMPILE_TIMEOUT=120s and restarting.
Ava (oncall): Patch applied to restarted pods' env. Monitoring for regressions.
DeployBot: Canary route adjusted -> 20% fallback / 80% primary
Ravi (runtime): Running checksum across model shards stored in object store. Suspect one shard mismatch.
Marta (sre): Checksum (s3) reveals mismatch on model-shard-7 for gpt-xl-8bit v2. Restoring from last-good snapshot.
Ava (oncall): Restore started, will rewarm model after restore. ETA ~8m.
Luis (cs): Messaging update: we restored shard from snapshot and are serving traffic on fallback in the meantime.
Ravi (runtime): After restore and rewarm, loads succeed on previously failing nodes. No further deserialization OOMs observed.
Marta (sre): Node drain/un-cordon scheduled, verifying pod stability.
Ava (oncall): Post-mortem actions: add shard checksum verification to model publish lifecycle; auto-fallback to smaller variant on deserialization failure; increase default compile timeout to 90s; improved runbook steps for draining and restart flags. Filing tickets.
Ravi (runtime): Root cause summary: corrupted shard + aggressive JIT compile timing under concurrency caused cuBLAS exec failures and OOM at load.
Marta (sre): Incident severity downgraded. Handing monitoring to next rotation.
Ava (oncall): Handoff: @Ravi will continue watch for 1h then update oncall rotation. I updated the incident doc with timeline, commands used, and checksums.
IncidentBot: Incident closed 1798501234 at 2026-03-14T17:36:00Z
Luis (cs): Customers cust-A and cust-B confirmed recovered. Closing customer tickets.
Ava (oncall): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: great runbook usage and quick mitigation.
